purpose: 通过普通 Go 库调用示例展示 cut 更名后的登记关系、旧名截止查询的 nil 与错误，以及 gate 截止传播的结果。
output:
Register("source", []) err=<nil>
Register("cut", [source]) err=<nil>
Register("report", [cut]) err=<nil>
Register("view", [report]) err=<nil>
Rename("cut", "gate") err=<nil>
source  parents=[] children=[gate]
cut     <unregistered>
gate    parents=[source] children=[report]
report  parents=[gate] children=[view]
view    parents=[report] children=[]
ImpactsWithCutoffs("source", [cut]) count=0 nil=true err=cutoff dataset not found: cut
ImpactsWithCutoffs("source", [gate]) count=1 nil=false err=<nil>
  gate    distance=1 path=[source gate]

purpose: 展示旧名重新登记后的双向依赖，分别以 cut、gate 截止查询的距离与路径，并显示普通查询选择 gate 的较短路线。
output:
Register("source", []) err=<nil>
Register("cut", [source]) err=<nil>
Register("report", [cut]) err=<nil>
Register("view", [report]) err=<nil>
Rename("cut", "gate") err=<nil>
Register("cut", [source]) err=<nil>
Register("bridge", [cut]) err=<nil>
Register("report", [gate bridge]) err=<nil>
source  parents=[] children=[gate cut]
cut     parents=[source] children=[bridge]
gate    parents=[source] children=[report]
bridge  parents=[cut] children=[report]
report  parents=[gate bridge] children=[view]
view    parents=[report] children=[]
ImpactsWithCutoffs("source", [cut]) count=4 nil=false err=<nil>
  cut     distance=1 path=[source cut]
  gate    distance=1 path=[source gate]
  report  distance=2 path=[source gate report]
  view    distance=3 path=[source gate report view]
ImpactsWithCutoffs("source", [gate]) count=5 nil=false err=<nil>
  cut     distance=1 path=[source cut]
  gate    distance=1 path=[source gate]
  bridge  distance=2 path=[source cut bridge]
  report  distance=3 path=[source cut bridge report]
  view    distance=4 path=[source cut bridge report view]
Impacts("source") count=5 nil=false err=<nil>
  cut     distance=1 path=[source cut]
  gate    distance=1 path=[source gate]
  bridge  distance=2 path=[source cut bridge]
  report  distance=2 path=[source gate report]
  view    distance=3 path=[source gate report view]
